blocks.title: Modular programming
blocks.text: Modular programming divides a program into smaller, manageable and reusable pieces called modules, so developers can work on parts independently and reuse code efficiently.
This approach makes complex programs easier to manage and promotes code reuse. Using the main function with modules keeps the code organized and easy to maintain (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Explain why modular programming is useful in Python (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Splitting a program into modules keeps each part small and focused, lets several people work at once, avoids repeating code because a module can be imported anywhere, and makes errors easier to find and fix.

items: Modular programming: split a program into reusable modules; easier management, teamwork and reuse.
